text:
anya: Kicking off a quick dual-profile smoke for a new q8b-int4 bring-up. Goal: side-by-side check default vs lcd quant profiles on our prompt bank before canary. Target slices: longform summaries, instruction-following, code snippets, and top traffic intents.
sam: Sounds good. We should run both profiles per prompt so labelers can compare diffs. Also include the adversarial-md5-50 set and the golden-coverage-200.
lee: I'll generate a stratified sample (intent x length_bucket x modality). Plan: ~1600 total rows but will output 2 rows per prompt (one per profile) for side-by-side. Steps: exact-token dedupe -> fuzzy cluster collapse (95% sim) -> attach metadata.
anya: Keep the near-duplicate cluster file aside, don't feed to labelers. We want minimal noise.
maria: Create a temporary labeling campaign: q8b-int4-dual-smoke. Note: regression-only; label severity and regression_type; first 350 edgecases -> senior reviewers.
labeler-ops-bot: @maria created campaign q8b-int4-dual-smoke (1600 tasks) assigned to "smoke-reviewers"; tags_required=[severity,regression_type,notes]; quick_review=true; ETA=48h.
sam: Per-sample metadata required: sample_id, prompt_hash, intent, length_bucket, model_variant, quant_profile, decode_params, seed, baseline_model, batch_id. Also include numerical prefilter fields: overlap_ratio, rougeL_delta, bleu_delta.
lee: CSV header will be: sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model_variant,quant_profile,decode_params,seed,baseline_model,batch_id,overlap_ratio,rougeL_delta,bleu_delta,flag_reason
lee: Uploaded initial batch (800 unique prompts -> 1600 rows) to s3://redwood-qa/q8b-int4/dual_profile/2026-03-23_batchA.csv
anya: Add automated prefilter rules so labelers see high-probability regressions first: flag if overlap_ratio < 0.65 OR rougeL_delta < -0.10 OR bleu_delta < -0.12. Tag reason in flag_reason column.
sam: Pseudo-checker for the job:
```
overlap = tok_overlap(baseline, candidate)
if overlap / baseline_tokens < 0.65:
    flag_reason = "low_overlap"
elif rougeL(candidate, baseline) - rougeL_baseline < -0.10:
    flag_reason = "rouge_drop"
elif bleu(candidate, baseline) - bleu_baseline < -0.12:
    flag_reason = "bleu_drop"
else:
    flag_reason = "none"
```
maria: Label schema: severity in [none/minor/major/critical], regression_type in [hallucination,omission,formatting,code-safety,other], notes text. For code prompts add exec_risk boolean. First 350 labeled by seniors; remaining by rotating pool.
anya: Decision rules documented: pause rollout if instruction-accuracy delta > 5% (relative), OR any critical hallucination found, OR code exec_risk count increases > 3x vs baseline. Otherwise proceed with phased canary.
lee: Also included a tiny auto-diff artifact that snapshots baseline & candidate outputs to s3 for any flagged sample: s3://redwood-qa/q8b-int4/dual_profile/flags/{sample_id}.json.
sam: Good. Please also include per-intent aggregates in the job output: flagged_count, avg_bleu_delta, severity_histogram. We'll wire that into the canary ticket and dashboard.
labeler-ops-bot: Campaign q8b-int4-dual-smoke updated: reviewers=senior(3)/rotating(6); auto-tags=[prefilter,code_exec_flag]; priority=high.
lee: Job run stats: unique_prompts=800, rows_output=1600 (2 profiles), deduped=792, flagged_prefilter=124, code_exec_autoflags=9. CSV with metadata and flags uploaded.
maria: Scheduling senior shifts now. For ambiguous labels route to regression-triage thread with examples. Use tag "regression-signal" on all labels in this campaign.
anya: Once 350 senior labels land, run the eval harness for: instruction_accuracy_delta, hallucination_count_delta, rougeL_mean_delta, code_exec_risk_delta. Produce a one-page executive summary and recommended action (roll-forward / tweak-quant / pause-and-fallback).
sam: If we see concentrated regressions in specific intents, we can route those intents to fp16 fallback in Dedicated or try the lcd profile only for those intents.
lee: Note: included side-by-side rows use model_variant names: franklin-fp16 (baseline), q8b-int4-default, q8b-int4-lcd. For side-by-side comparison we generated candidate rows for both q8b variants.
anya: Thanks team. Keep updates in-thread and concise. I'll post the harness verdict after first 350 are labeled. :thumbsup:
